participant_instructions: Answer from the repository at the exact target revision.
Trace the named production entry point and any helpers needed to explain observable control flow, mutations, yielded/returned values, and exceptions.
Support each material claim with an inline citation in the form `relative/path.py:start-end`.
Do not rely on tests, runtime experiments, or prior benchmark answers as a substitute for source reasoning.

tasks.title: StateGraph compilation pipeline
tasks.prompt: Trace `StateGraph.compile(...)` end to end. Explain checkpointer and strict-serialization preparation; graph and interrupt validation; output and stream channel selection; how graph-level error-handler, retry, cache, and timeout defaults mutate node specs and where per-node settings win; how the `CompiledStateGraph` is configured; and the order in which nodes, mappers, edges, waiting edges, and branches are attached before final validation.

tasks.title: Bulk checkpoint state updates
tasks.prompt: Trace `Pregel.bulk_update_state(config, supersteps)` through every major mode. Explain initial validation and subgraph delegation; saved-versus-fresh checkpoint setup; the special END, INPUT, and `__copy__` paths and their invalid cases; ordinary `as_node` inference and ambiguity rules; writer execution and task-ID reuse; how normal, PUSH, and pending writes are persisted; how delta snapshot metadata is chosen; and how multiple supersteps advance the returned config.

tasks.title: Message reducer replacement and deletion
tasks.prompt: Trace `add_messages(left, right, format=...)` from input normalization to its return. Explain scalar/list and message-chunk conversion, missing-ID assignment, REMOVE_ALL behavior, replacement versus append ordering, deletion and later resurrection of an existing ID, the nonexistent-ID deletion error, and both supported and rejected formatting paths.
